name: Moonbrook Espionage
summary: Alba Fairmoon sends you to scout Moonbrook, where signs of industry trouble the Alliance. The poison found across Westfall does not seem to come from the lesser mines, so attention turns to the Deadmines beneath the town.

sections.title: A Toxic Trail
sections.body: The mines already examined across Westfall offer no answer to the poison spreading through the region. No known surface excavation appears to be its source. One major site remains unexplored: the vast shafts of the Deadmines, directly beneath Moonbrook’s ruined streets.

sections.title: Secrets of the Deadmines
sections.body: Accounts say the Deadmines were abandoned after the Horde overran the region during the First War. Yet modern industrial gear and supplies lie scattered through Moonbrook. Their presence points to an extensive mining and manufacturing operation hidden behind the ruined town’s empty appearance.

faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon assigns you to investigate Moonbrook. She has been looking into suspicious toxins and industrial activity across contested Westfall.
The other local mines show no sign of producing the poison Alba is investigating. Moonbrook lies directly above the Deadmines, so she suspects an illicit operation beneath the town.
The Deadmines are the region’s deepest and most expansive gold mines. They have been considered empty ruins since Stormwind fell in the First War, though vermin and bandits are said to haunt them.

faq.q: What items are gathered during this scouting mission?
faq.answer: Scouts are sent to retrieve Suspicious Industrial Supplies scattered throughout Moonbrook. The supplies point to active industrial work and refining near the mine shafts.

faq.q: What threats occupy Moonbrook right now?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood overran Moonbrook and uses its derelict buildings as a forward staging ground. They guard the surface entrance to the underground network.

faq.q: What does finding these supplies prove?
faq.answer: Modern, heavy industrial equipment in a town believed abandoned points to a coordinated faction carrying out large-scale fabrication beyond Stormwind’s authorities’ sight.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can slip through Moonbrook to gather intelligence on Defias operations without raising the alarm.
As a miner, you know the wealth and logistical scale of the deep shafts beneath Moonbrook.
As an Alliance member, you know active industry in Moonbrook threatens Westfall’s breadbasket and Stormwind’s security.
